name: Silero-VAD
headline: Lightweight, high-accuracy voice activity detection model for real-time speech/silence classification.
description: Silero VAD is a compact, production-ready Voice Activity Detection model trained on a large multilingual corpus. It processes 32 ms audio chunks at 16 kHz and outputs a speech probability per chunk, enabling real-time detection of speech segments in streaming or file-based audio. The model uses an LSTM-based architecture and is well-suited for edge deployment on Qualcomm Snapdragon devices.
research_paper_title: Silero VAD - pre-trained enterprise-grade Voice Activity Detector
